description: Translate entities by a world-space offset [dx, dy, dz], atomically and in memory: all of them move or none do. Works on LINE, CIRCLE, ARC, POINT and 3DFACE (the families with a byte-exact writer); circles and arcs with a non-default extrusion are refused. Other types are refused by name. Hosted created drawings auto-save; other drawings use cad.save_as. Rotate and scale are not available yet.
name: cad.move_entities
